stem: In paragraph 5, in what way does the information about the findings in the Harvard study support the author's argument?

options.label: A
options.text: The findings confirm that many people appreciate walking.

options.label: B
options.text: The findings explain why people choose to take walks.

options.label: C
options.text: The findings prove that walking has desirable results.

options.label: D
options.text: The findings show how often people go for a walk.
